units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:8">Ex. R. s. 42</cite>, end [read:] <he>לשון סורסי הוא … כך אני מרפא אותן וכ׳</he> (v. <cite ref="O00435"><he>סוּרְסִי</he></cite>) it is a contraction; the Lord says, ‘Shall I thus cure them?’, as we read (<cite ref="Exodus 32:8-9">Ex. XXXII, 8—9</cite>): ‘They have made themselves a molten calf’ … ‘and the Lord said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiffnecked people’ (i.e. it is incurable).
